top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs a quantitative prediction (Bistritzer-MacDonald flat bands at a magic twist angle) with the 2018 observation of correlated insulating and superconducting states at that angle. The three names map onto the decisive steps, the phenomenology is reproduced across laboratories, and the twist angle is a general control parameter for interlayer registry and interaction strength. The citation avoids the unsettled pairing mechanism; the costs are the short eight-year record and the omission of Cao and parallel experimental groups. P003 is the mature, stable alternative but its Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang and Hasan omissions are harder to defend; P002 has the cleanest credit but sits closer to the 2005 and 2012 AMO prizes with its payoff still ahead; P004 overlaps the 2012 prize and leaves Wineland-lineage and Monroe-type work uncredited. No award ranks last because several credible, awardable cases exist.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; Goran Johansson is a Chalmers colleague but is not a credited name on any proposal, and the Japan and microscopy connections do not involve any credited laureate.
